info.title: Roadrunner Phase 20 API
info.description: One serialized operational authority with optional PostgreSQL/PostGIS durability. Bearer capabilities and Idempotency-Key are required for commands. Clients supply intent and explicit graph projections; server owns identities, clocks, policy, execution and temporal publication. All numeric times are absolute seconds in /v1/state time_domain. Simulation is isolated. Durable mode preserves outcomes across restart under one fenced writer. Event consumers process committed integration facts; they cannot bypass operational commands. No multi-primary guarantee.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Original Idempotency-Key scoped to authenticated principal

parameters.name: X-Roadrunner-Namespace
parameters.description: Original world reference; old volatile namespace returns unknown conflict

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Delivery uses its opaque order reference

deadline_seconds.description: Absolute seconds in the advertised server time domain.

policy.description: Configured policy name; clients cannot assert accepted terms.

outcome.description: pending, committed, completed, noncommit, or rejected.

published.description: True only when this command published a business effect. Context adoption is recorded separately in revision/history.

result.description: Immutable original result/evidence, never recomputed for a retry.

revision.description: Lossless decimal revision at completion, independent of command count.

coordinates.description: `GeoJSON` longitude/latitude positions in directed traversal order.

Location.description: A graph-qualified, explicit node projection. No snapping or off-road connector.

kind.description: distance or `travel_time`; value units are meters or seconds respectively.

observation_id.description: Stable source identity, independently recognized across HTTP commands.

observed_at_seconds.description: Absolute seconds; future observations reject. Receipt is recorded separately.

sequence.description: Contiguous sequence per source/resource, beginning at 1.

source.description: Source bound to the authenticated observer credential.

alternatives.description: Count including primary, 1..=5; used only by alternatives endpoint.

departure_time.description: RFC 3339 UTC/offset timestamp. Defaults to the authoritative server clock.

route_records.description: Phase 21 durable recording identities; absent in volatile mode.

truncated.description: Alternatives only: true when enumeration hit a budget.

scenario.description: Existing versioned `SimulationScenario` contract; runs on the pinned server graph.

dynamic_events.description: Optional schema 4 dynamic events; see docs/simulation.md and phase-19 fixtures.

overrides.description: Complete replacement; omitted directed edges return to normal traffic.
